result.scope: The Riemann zeta function and every Dirichlet L-function (Mathlib definitions), and every finite-order residue Hecke L-function over Q(zeta_3) = Q(sqrt(-3)) in the original OpenAI HeckeFamily definition; strict half-plane Re s > 10499/12000; the trivial-character pole at s = 1 excluded. Not general GRH.

method: Weighted fourth moment of the reconstructed and reflected physical numerator, with selected prime factors and joint Euler coefficient bounds. Original kappa=3/4 throughout. No lower-kappa feedback or Li Xiang refinement is an input.
analytic_status: Written analytic argument (research_audit/weighted_numerator_proof.tex and weighted_numerator_lemma.tex) with an end-to-end Lean formalization. The Lean development proves WeightedQRH.beta_le_theta : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta <= 10499/12000 and the zeta, Dirichlet and Hecke nonvanishing endpoints; every endpoint depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, on top of the imported original development (akashlevy/math@c388e88e6, pruned from openai/math fd4aeeb2e) and Mathlib. The former remaining input FullWAnalyticInput is proved (WeightedQRH.fullW_analytic_input := fullW_input_of_raw_source Numerator.actual_raw_fullW_input). Isolated rebuild and local Comparator checks pass (see lean_verification). No external human peer review. The manuscript (weighted_numerator_proof.tex, weighted_numerator_lemma.tex) has been revised to this status, recompiled and fully re-rendered (see pdf_review).
verification_limits: No external human peer review; checking is mechanical (Lean kernel) plus AI-assisted reading.

The original analytic inputs are imported as compiled Lean from akashlevy/math@c388e88e6 (openai/math fd4aeeb2e pruned in place), not re-proved here; the written proof cites the September-30 paper's lemmas.

The isolated rebuild recompiled the 228 local WeightedQRH modules in the endpoints' import closure and the 3 challenge modules; the original-development, Mathlib and dependency objects were supplied prebuilt, not rebuilt in this run. The source hashes in the Lake build traces of the original-development objects were compared with the c388e88e6 sources and agree (reimplemented Lake hash; that comparison is not recorded in an evidence file). The same object directory also holds stale objects of 253 modules deleted by the prune; verify_parallel.py admits an external OAI import only if its module is tracked at c388e88e6, which excludes them.

WeightedQRH/ has 252 .lean files; 24 of them (audit/*Axioms modules, CertificateBenchmark, FullWAnalyticAudit, HighRows.MixedCollected and others) lie outside the endpoints' import closure and were not part of the isolated rebuild. WeightedQRH.theta_lt_public_cubic_lower (CertificateBenchmark.lean) was compiled only in the live development tree.

FinalAxioms.log prints axioms for 10 declarations (source_integrated_amplitude_classes, actual_raw_fullW_input, fullW_analytic_input, the four Final endpoints, the three Statements theorems); every theorem on their proof paths is covered transitively. physical_low_barrier is off the proof path and not covered by that log.

Comparator ran locally on macOS with an unsandboxed Landrun stand-in and a lake-build shim that only confirms prebuilt isolated objects exist; export, statement/definition comparison, axiom check and full kernel replay ran unchanged. Default Lean kernel only; NanoDa and con-ron second kernels have not been run.

Scope: zeta and all Dirichlet L-functions (Mathlib definitions) and finite-order residue Hecke characters of Q(zeta_3) in the original OpenAI definition; not general GRH. The half-plane is strict (Re s > 10499/12000) and the trivial-character pole at s = 1 is excluded.
The 13/15 barrier is a limitation of the stated low estimates only.
The public comparison is dated (as_of_utc) and is not an exhaustive novelty proof; outside claims and their verification reports were read, not rerun.

public_comparison.claimants: Written: GPT-6 Astra and Joseph M. Shunia; Jizhou Guo. Lean package: Nielstron, in the open, unmerged GTimG/QuasiRiemannTracker PR #2 (checks reported by the PR author).
public_comparison.exact_improvement: 10499/12000 is smaller than the cubic root by about 4.0353e-5 (0.0000403527534322794619...). The Lean lemma WeightedQRH.theta_lt_public_cubic_lower (CertificateBenchmark.lean) proves theta < 8749570194/10^10, the lower end of the cubic-root bracket. CertificateBenchmark.lean is a stand-alone module outside the endpoints' import closure and the isolated rebuild (compiled in the live development tree only). WeightedQRH.theta_lt_public (Parameters.lean, inside the closure and the isolated rebuild) proves theta < 874957019420098946128604623/10^27, the tracker's listed rational.
public_comparison.conditional_or_excluded: Guo 328/375 = 0.874666... is below 10499/12000 but is stated by its source to be conditional on unproved Hypothesis 11.1; it is excluded from the unconditional comparison. Chakhkiev 10937/12500 is self-described as conditional. Li Xiang's cubic sigma* Lean theorem carries an explicit hypothesis (README and metadata only were read; no proof code was fetched or reused).
public_comparison.coverage: Dated search, not an exhaustive novelty proof. Outside claims and their verification reports were read, not rerun. No outside refinement proof code was fetched, imported, executed or reproduced.

barrier.scope: Unchanged stated Gram and reflected-row low majorants; not a lower bound on actual zeros and not a no-go theorem for different estimates or probes.
